title: Hungerburgbahn Zaha-Hadid-Stationen
highlights: Futuristische Standseilbahn mit vier weltberühmten Stationen von Stararchitektin Zaha Hadid
Organisch geschwungene Glasdächer, inspiriert von den Formen alpiner Gletscherwelten
Spektakuläre Überquerung des Inns über die markante Schrägseilbrücke
Verbindet das Stadtzentrum von Innsbruck in nur 8 Minuten mit der Hungerburg
kurzbeschreibung: The Hungerburgbahn in Innsbruck connects the old town and the Nordkette with futuristic architecture by star architect Zaha Hadid.
beschreibung:
Architectural Icon by Zaha Hadid

The Hungerburgbahn in Innsbruck sets architectural benchmarks worldwide. British-Iraqi star architect Zaha Hadid designed the four striking stations, whose flowing shell shapes evoke alpine landscapes of ice and snow.

From City to Mountain in Eight Minutes

The modern funicular railway departs in the heart of the city centre near the Kongresshaus, crosses the Inn over a daring bridge structure, and takes passengers up to the Hungerburg in just eight minutes. There, a magnificent panoramic view opens up over the provincial capital.
